title: Researchers allege DeepSeek, Kimi, and other Chinese AI models were trained using banned Nvidia Blackwell GPUs
content: Researchers pinpoint that DeepSeek, Kimi, and other Chinese AI models were trained on export-controlled Nvidia Blackwell chips — statistical analysis on model weights reveals high correlation to Nvidia hardware

title: Lawyer’s eight-V100 AI server moves DeepSeek from 2-bit to near-NVFP4 precision
content: A lawyer’s eight-GPU Nvidia V100 server now runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash’s most-used experts at NVFP4 precision instead of 2-bit.

title: China’s Air Force builds drone that shoots painkiller darts at wounded soldiers
content: The Air Force Medical University of the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) built this drone so it could remotely administer pain killers to injured soldiers and make extraction easier.

title: Nearly 20 years after launch, ancient AMD Radeon HD 2000 and 3000 GPUs finally get a Linux fix for corrupted video playback
content: A new kernel contributor used AI to develop a patch for the drivers powering his nearly-20-year-old Radeon GPU.

title: Neousys Technology posts record quarter as defense, AGV/AMR demand accelerates
content: Industrial PC maker Neousys Technology posted record operating performance in 3Q26, driven by project customer shipments and peak shipments to the North American market. The company expects growth from defense, edge AI, and applications involving automated guided vehicles (AGVs) and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), while adding humanoid robots and healthcare development in 2027.

title: Gemtek returns to profitability on direct-supply expansion, eyes AI infrastructure and optical module growth in 2027
content: Taiwan-based networking equipment maker Gemtek Technology is gaining momentum in its business recovery following a challenging business-model transition, returning to operating profitability in the third quarter of 2026 as margins improved and direct-supply sales expanded. The company expects fourth-quarter performance to remain at a similar level, supported by resilient demand for networking products and the gradual recovery of its high-value-added businesses.

title: Etron plans strategic stake in Powerchip Innovation Investment
content: Memory IC designer Etron Technology reported strong Q3 2026 results on robust memory demand and rising product prices, with revenue reaching NT$6.792 billion (US$206.6 million), up 38.6% quarter-over-quarter and 535% year-over-year. Net income attributable to the parent company came to NT$2.493 billion, or earnings per share (EPS) of NT$7.59, reversing a loss of NT$1.74 per share in the same period of 2025.

title: Pegatron sees networking recovery in 2027 as consumer electronics growth eases after peak
content: Pegatron held an online earnings call on November 12, providing updates and an outlook for its product lines beyond servers. The company said revenue from all three major product lines of information products, consumer electronics, and communications recorded double-digit sequential growth in the third quarter of 2026, benefiting from seasonal demand. title: A reporter's perspective: The Jensen Huang I have known for more than 20 years
content: Editor’s note: Monica Chen is a senior DIGITIMES journalist who has covered Nvidia, Jensen Huang, and the company’s Taiwan supply chain for more than two decades. She has interviewed Huang many times and followed Nvidia through major changes in the technology industry.

title: AI server tracker: Aspeed tops NT$2 billion as cable suppliers diverge
content: Aspeed Technology posted its highest monthly revenue in records dating back to January 2019. BizLink's October sales also rose sharply, partly reflecting its first full month of consolidating Interplex Datacom. Four other cable and connector suppliers reported lower revenue than in September, although four of the five suppliers posted year-to-date growth.

title: Huang's resignation unlikely to disrupt Taiwan's AI industry, Acer founder says
content: Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia's CEO is unlikely to disrupt Taiwan's technology industry or the broader development of artificial intelligence, Acer founder Stan Shih said. His comments signal that Taiwan's chip and server capabilities remain important to Nvidia's expansion, while highlighting potential adjustments in supplier relationships, investment, and market expectations.

title: Jensen Huang’s exit threatens to upend Nvidia’s global AI funding network
content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's forced resignation over a personal controversy, alongside looming regulatory and legal battles, is set to reverberate far beyond GPU orders and product roadmaps. His departure directly threatens the sprawling global AI investment and financing network he personally orchestrated, leaving multiple pending deals in limbo.

title: UK steel city's deep-tech push faces mass-production and talent hurdles
content: The United Kingdom's steelmaking hub of Sheffield is transforming from a heavy-industry center into a deep-tech startup cluster, but securing a foothold in the AI, quantum, and photonics wave will require the city to overcome both the mass-production barriers facing high-tech products and a shortage of talent.

title: AI lifts Foxconn profits as ROE targets 12%
content: Foxconn (Hon Hai) expects continued operational growth in 2027 as AI demand expands, chairman Young Liu said at the company's third-quarter 2026 earnings briefing on November 12. However, he warned that supply-chain constraints and global economic and political uncertainty will continue to affect the company's operations, investment decisions, and supply-chain planning.
